summary: Originality comes easy to you. You think for yourself without effort and break the mold without drama. Freedom and selfhood flow together.
body: Originality comes easy to you. You think for yourself without effort and break the mold without drama. Freedom and selfhood flow together. You can be unconventional without alienating people, the rare mix of original and easy to be around. Because it's natural, the risk is coasting, letting the easy originality stand in for actually building something new. Put it to work and you become the person who quietly moves things forward.
gift: At your best: original and easy with it, free without the friction.
shadow: The trap: coasting on natural originality instead of building anything new with it.
integration: Let freedom become a practice, not only a reaction. Your difference has more impact when it can be trusted over time.
do: Build the new thing, don't just sense it
Use the ease to go further
